comment: What npm ships: src/ compiled to ESM and .d.ts in dist/, the tests left out. The workspace never reads dist/; its exports still point at src/, and publishConfig.exports is the manifest a consumer gets (tag.yml writes it over exports before npm publish). The svelte/ subpath is not built here: its components import ../src/*.ts and need svelte-package to ship, so it stays a workspace entry until then.
